d:
From mysterious shipwrecks to extraordinary discoveries beneath the waves, Jeremy Wade dives into some of the most fascinating ocean mysteries from Season 1. Each investigation uncovers strange clues, forgotten stories and underwater secrets that raise questions about what the deep sea still holds.
How much of the ocean’s history remains hidden beneath the surface?
Watch Mysteries of the Deep, Season 1, Episodes 4, 9, 6, 10, 8, 7 and 1, on Discovery Channel India.
